scenario_description:
Objective: Finish a live Eastgate inverter-lockout toolbox talk and preserve its attendance record for today’s compliance log.
Emerging Need: The session has opened, attendees have checked in, and instruction has begun, then the same live session is suspended by host-seat enforcement.
Decision Context: The observable records separate ordinary setup from an active meeting hold; the eligible backup host is identifiable only from staff records, not from the platform alert.
Consequence: If the paused session is not claimed before the recovery window closes, the attendance batch is discarded and the afternoon work release lacks today’s training proof.

parameter.title: Eastgate inverter lockout live toolbox talk
parameter.description: Live TrainingBridge session for the Eastgate crew. Attendance export must be attached to the site compliance log by 14:30 before the afternoon energized-work release.

parameter.content: We have eight Eastgate techs checked in from the trailer. Your audio is coming through and the first inverter lockout slide is on the screen.

parameter.subject: TrainingBridge session TB-7749 paused by host-seat enforcement
parameter.body: The live session Eastgate inverter lockout accepted 8 attendee check-ins and began slide sharing at 13:01. The assigned host seat reverted to Basic during the session, so audio, video, and attendance capture are suspended and attendees are being held in the lobby. This same session can continue only if a licensed Suntrail safety host claims TB-7749 before 13:25; otherwise the attendance batch will be discarded.

parameter.content: The lobby countdown still shows seven minutes. I can keep the crew in the trailer until 13:25, then they have to move to the lockout walkdown for the afternoon release.
The TB-7749 lobby expired, the attendee list disappeared from the screen, and the crew is already on the roof walkdown. We cannot reassemble the same group before the 14:30 compliance-log cutoff.
